This '''wine''' was a type of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] that originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gand (planet)/Legends|Gand]]. A bottle of this [[Wine/Legends|wine]] was brought aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
